_comment: Bundle budgets (bytes). A ratchet: ceilings pin today's build and may only go down. initial = entry script + modulepreloaded chunks + css from index.html. Known exception: vendor-echarts is still preloaded at first load (1.1 MB); shrinking it is tracked, growing it is a failure. Raised once, Owner-approved 2026-10-30: entry_script_bytes 2400000 -> 2405000 (+5000) for the request-loop guard (lib/guardedFetch.ts + requestLoopGuard.ts + the common.requestBlocked strings in the eager locales), a safety backstop that must load with the first request; it put the entry at 2402282. Reclaimable: lib/mock fixtures ship in the production entry chunk behind a runtime ?mock=1 flag; moving them out should let this ceiling come back down.
